reason: The free app already does what I need and I'll probably drift off it in two weeks like every other one. Why pay for a widget or hats before I know I'll still be opening it.
objection: I'll probably stop using it in two weeks, so even $4.99 feels like money for something I'll forget.
would_change_my_mind: If I was still using it daily after the 7 days and the lock-screen widget made starting tasks actually easier, I might get just the $1.99 Start Kit.
